# GWS Gmail Read

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — one subcommand of the gws CLI: read a Gmail message by ID and extract its body or headers, with flags for output format (text/json), HTML vs plain text, and multipart/base64 decoding handled automatically. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. Follows the same pattern as the other gws-* listings (gws-docs, gws-sheets-read, gws-gmail-send, gws-gmail-triage…): a focused, documented subcommand rather than the whole tool. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags; the skill documents the command — it doesn't set up your Google Cloud auth for you. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
